23template <size_t Size> class BufferImpl : public Buffer {
24public:
25 const uint8_t *data() const override { return m_data; }
26 const size_t &length() const override { return m_length; }
27 size_t size() const override { return sizeof(m_data); }
28
29 void clear() override
30 {
31 std::fill_n(m_data, size(), 0);
32 m_length = 0;
33 }
34
35 bool append(const uint8_t *data, size_t length) override
36 {
37 if (m_length + length > size()) {
38 return false;
39 }
40
41 std::copy_n(data, length, &m_data[m_length]);
42 m_length += length;
43
44 return true;
45 }
46
47 bool shift(size_t count) override
48 {
49 if (count > m_length) {
50 return false;
51 }
52
53 if (count > 0) {
54 m_length -= count;
55 std::copy_n(m_data + count, m_length, m_data);
56 std::fill_n(m_data + m_length, size() - m_length, 0);
57 }
58
59 return true;
60 }
61
62private:
63 uint8_t m_data[Size]{};
64 size_t m_length = 0;
65};
